h1: Wearable AI that gives independence back.
lede: Nexable is the assistive-aids range from Purview Technologies: AI wearables and companions built for people with sight, hearing and daily-living needs. SEVA, Maitri and Silenta put recognition, navigation, reading and conversation into a device that works hands free, with no smartphone required.

blocks.title: Three aids, one purpose: independence
blocks.body: SEVA for people with low vision or blindness; Maitri and Silenta extending the same AI wearable platform to other assistive needs. Specifications, demos and ordering on the Purview Technologies site.

blocks.text: The most human use of our AI stack

Nexable takes the same vision, voice and language engineering that Purview sells to enterprises and points it at people: a camera that reads a bus stop, a voice that describes a painting, a wearable that keeps someone connected. It is the clearest proof that Purview’s AI works in the real world, in real time, for people who depend on it.

items.title: SEVA: AI smart glasses for low vision and blindness
items.body: Facial recognition, object and product detection, scene navigation with directional feedback, text magnification and contrast, reading printed and handwritten text aloud, with a built-in AI assistant. Self-powered, no subscription for software updates.

items.title: Navigation and recognition
items.body: Real-time scene understanding, obstacle and landmark cues, people and product recognition, on the device.

items.title: Reading and communication
items.body: Printed, on-screen and handwritten text read aloud; conversation support through the built-in assistant.

items.title: Support, training and updates
items.body: Onboarding for users and carers, partner training for assessment centres, and over-the-air software updates.

items.title: Assess
items.body: Users try the device at an assessment centre or partner, or through a Purview-arranged demo.

items.title: Fit and set up
items.body: Device fitted and personalised: voice, language, contacts and preferences.

items.title: Learn
items.body: Guided onboarding for the user and, where helpful, family or carers.

items.title: Use
items.body: Hands-free operation through voice and a tap, with spoken feedback.

items.title: Update and support
items.body: Software updates and support from Purview Technologies, with user feedback shaping the roadmap.

items.title: Designed, engineered and supported by Purview Technologies
items.body: Purview Technologies, the group’s AI and XR company, designs the devices and the software, partners with wearable manufacturers, and supports users and distribution partners in the UK, India, Africa and beyond.
